text: The current test clicks a javascript:void(0) fixture anchor in a content process, waits 500 ms and closes the tab. It checks survival of the spawned task, not a changed DOM result proving script semantics. Preserve that crash-regression purpose in test descriptions; a broader execution or accessibility claim would need additional assertions and a runtime run. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Keep the javascript-link crash test limit explicit
